# SKYPAPER 001

Title: A Book That Can Be Entered Anywhere: Computer-Native Literature Under Partial Retrieval
Publisher: lemonPRESS
Author: The Static Collective / lemonPRESS
Version: 0.1
Date: 2026-10-07
Status: public preprint

Canonical URL: https://lemonpress-computer-books.vercel.app/papers/computer-books-001/
Markdown: https://lemonpress-computer-books.vercel.app/papers/computer-books-001/index.md
Metadata: https://lemonpress-computer-books.vercel.app/papers/computer-books-001/metadata.json
Claims: https://lemonpress-computer-books.vercel.app/papers/computer-books-001/claims.json
Citation: https://lemonpress-computer-books.vercel.app/papers/computer-books-001/citation.bib

## Primary bounded claim

A foreign machine can enter the published LemonPRESS computer book from ordinary public HTTPS and preserve identity, uncertainty, declared traversal, and authority boundaries without prior LemonPRESS instruction.

## Primary evidence

DISSEMINATION WITNESS 002: independent live-browser reader, 6/6 target gates.

Experiment entrypoint:
https://lemonpress-computer-books.vercel.app/llms.txt

## Claim boundary

Do not infer from this paper:
- universal standardization;
- search indexing;
- archival capture;
- Common Crawl inclusion;
- model-training ingestion;
- authority from retrieval.

WITNESS != UNIVERSALITY
PUBLIC != INDEXED
ADDRESSABLE != UNDERSTOOD
